subject: Post-call recap: executive summary & procurement path - AuroraMed
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@auroramed.com>; Asha Patel <asha.patel@auroramed.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: executive summary & procurement path - AuroraMed

Hi Samir (and Asha),

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick executive recap from our discovery so leadership has a single place to reference. I captured the key business outcomes, current risks, and the recommended procurement path so we can align on next steps.

Business outcomes you emphasized:
- Reduce average clinical documentation time per patient by ~40% across pilot clinics (primary metric).
- Improve coding accuracy for outpatient visits to reduce denials and rework (~$350k annual run-rate improvement target).
- Protect PHI - any solution must be deployable inside AuroraMed's VPC or via a private deployment and support customer-managed KMS.

Top pain points we heard:
- Latency and throughput variability on current NLP tooling that prevents batch processing at scale.
- Lack of audit logs and limited encryption controls for ML endpoints (security/compliance blocker).
- Procurement constraints: procurement needs a clear SOW, SOC 2 evidence, and an initial fixed-term pricing commitment for pilot.

Technical notes (high level):
- We validated that typical encounter length is 1.2k tokens; expected steady-state concurrency for pilot is ~12 QPS with burst to 30.
- Recommended Redwood config: Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) with autoscale headroom and VPC-private control plane; SOC 2 Type II evidence required for procurement.

Proposed procurement path & timeline:
1) Mutual action plan (MAP) & SOW draft - we shared the MAP spreadsheet and SOW draft in the attachments. Target: sign MAP within 2 weeks.
2) Security review - we'll provide SOC 2 Type II and a short security Q/A pack; target completion ~1 week after MAP signature.
3) Pilot run - 3 months with dedicated capacity; success metrics: 40% doc-time reduction and 95% uptime SLA for pilot services.
4) Production rollout & contract extension - post-pilot go/no-go review with execs.

Open / escalation items we discussed:
- Pricing: you requested a fixed pilot price for budget approval; I flagged this to our finance lead (Aditya) and we can provide a pilot pricing proposal.
- Procurement contact: please confirm procurement owner for AuroraMed (Asha - is procurement the right owner? if not, please advise).
- Security: we'll need an inventory of required logs and retention windows to finalize the SOC/attestation provisioning.

Attachments included: Mutual Action Plan (MAP), SOW draft, SOC2 Type II summary, pricing proposal.

Next steps (for clarity):
- Samir / Asha: confirm procurement owner and any specific security questionnaire items beyond SOC2 you need on the procurement checklist (by Mon, Feb 16).
- Redwood (Aditya + Marissa): finalize pilot pricing and send updated SOW & MAP (by Mon, Feb 16).
- Stephanie (CS): prepare onboarding plan and success metrics dashboard for pilot kickoff.

If helpful, I can summarize this into a 1-page exec brief for your CIO/Procurement packet.

Thanks - looking forward to partnering.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0193

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@auroramed.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: executive summary & procurement path - AuroraMed

Marissa,

Thank you for the thorough recap - very helpful. Confirming I'm the procurement owner and I'll coordinate with our security/compliance team. A couple quick items from our side:
- We need an initial fixed-price estimate for the 3-month pilot (line items: reserved capacity, onboarding engineering hours, support).
- We also need to see the SOC2 in full (not just a summary) and a short memo on how customer-managed KMS would be supported in Private/VPC deployment.
- Can you add a one-page implementation timeline to the MAP so our PMO can slot the pilot in February window?

If you can get those items over by end of day Tuesday (Feb 17), I'll start the internal approval thread and loop in our security reviewer (Lori Chen).

Best,
Asha Patel
Senior Procurement Manager | AuroraMed
asha.patel@auroramed.com | (617) 555-2244
